headlines.title: Judge temporarily halts Trump’s ‘Trash Island’ golf course redevelopment in D.C.
headlines.description: The Trump administration cannot close East Potomac Park to the public for now, a federal judge in Washington ruled Saturday, dealing a blow to the president’s effort to renovate the park’s golf course.

headlines.title: Democrat Mary Peltola is likely to win Alaska’s Senate race, as vote counting continues
headlines.description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola is likely to win Alaska’s Senate race, according to an NBC News Decision Desk analysis, as vote-counting continues in the state.

headlines.title: Transportation secretary says he doesn’t apologize for FAA’s nationwide ground stop
headlines.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy declined to apologize for the nationwide ground stop that stranded hundreds of thousands of travelers across the country

headlines.title: Sen.-elect Scott Colom says investing in the South can help Democrats win ‘a durable majority’
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Scott Colom, D-Miss., emphasized in that Democrats need to invest more in southern states like Mississippi, where he flipped the seat blue for the first time in decades.

headlines.title: Post Game: Can JD Vance clear primary field in 2028?
headlines.description: Carol Lee, Carlos Curbelo and Steve Ricchetti join the Meet the Press Post Game for an extended conversation on the week’s biggest political stories.

headlines.title: Mike Pence: If GOP doesn’t return to traditional values, ‘it won’t matter who we nominate in 2028’
headlines.description: Former Vice President Mike Pence joins Meet the Press to discuss if he believes Vice President JD Vance has what it takes to secure the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, and how the party moves forward after historic losses in the midterms.

headlines.title: Meet the Press Minute: Celebrating 100 Years of NBC
headlines.description: As NBC celebrates its 100th year of broadcasting, Meet the Press highlights the moment the network introduced color television to the nation from Washington, D.C.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Alaskans opt to stick with ranked choice voting
headlines.description: Alaskans have decided to stick with ranked choice voting, rejecting a ballot measure that sought to repeal the system, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins the Alaska governor’s race
headlines.description: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins has won the Alaska governor’s race, NBC News projects, flipping control of the office from Republicans.

headlines.title: Rubio urges conservatives to uplift their ideology, brushes off GOP midterm losses
headlines.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Friday downplayed Republicans’ devastating losses in the midterm elections, instead telling supporters, “Politics requires more than simply winning elections.”

headlines.title: Trump, Xi and Putin plan an unprecedented meeting on the sidelines of APEC, officials say
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will meet with the leaders of China and Russia on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzen, China’s tech hub, next week, an unprecedented gathering of the heads of the world’s biggest nuclear powers.
